title: C15 WEBB PHOTON TRUTH engineering data contract
description: Proposed record contract. No data have been collected by this generator. Null is missing/unknown and must be qualified in the separate provenance record.

exposure_id.x-quality-rule: Pin product checksum and processing level.

collecting_area.x-quality-rule: Do not double-count obscuration in both area and T.

throughput_pixel.x-quality-rule: Sum cannot exceed declared total registration probability.

wavefront_opd.x-quality-rule: Epoch and pupil coordinate registration required.

ramp.x-quality-rule: Read times and saturation masks retained.

metric_cov.x-quality-rule: MC and observation terms separately stored.

discrepancy_label.description: Optical, detector, calibration or resampling category.

x-unit-policy: Use documented units; do not replace missing values with zero. Reference frames, covariance basis, calibration version and quality qualifiers reside in the provenance sidecar.
x-domain-validation: Physical range, covariance validity and declared quality rules require domain validation beyond JSON Schema.
